title: eCommerce Template - Clothes Shop Free
description: A free e-commerce clothes shop website template featuring a modern, visually rich design for fashion retail. The template uses a clean white base with bold typography and lifestyle photography. The hero section features a large product image or model shot with overlaid collection name and CTA. The product grid shows items in a clean 3-4 column layout with thumbnail, name, price, and add-to-cart button. Product detail pages include multiple image views, size selectors, color swatches, material descriptions, and customer reviews. The shopping bag page itemizes selections with quantity controls, individual item prices, and total calculations. The checkout flow includes shipping information, payment method selection, and order confirmation. The design also includes a lookbook section with editorial-style fashion photography, and a blog with style guides and fashion tips. The color palette is neutral and sophisticated, letting product photography stand out. Typography uses a clean sans-serif throughout.
primary_use_case: E-commerce stores needing a free, clean online shop template with product grid, detail pages, cart, and checkout flow for clothing and fashion.
style_vibe: Clean, minimal fashion e-commerce with neutral palette and bold typography — product-focused design that lets clothing photography lead.
